description: This file defines an abstract class that provides common strategies for mapping between Adaptable objects and signals within a protocol adapter context. It includes methods for finding specific mapping strategies by type, extracting headers, checking response status, and deriving Thing IDs, tailored for subclasses implementing specific mapping strategies.

classes.name: AbstractMappingStrategies
classes.description: An abstract class that implements common functionality for mapping strategies related to Adaptable objects, including strategy lookup, header extraction, response status checking, and Thing ID derivation.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Retrieves a mapping strategy based on a given type string.

methods.name: dittoHeadersFrom
methods.description: Extracts Ditto headers from an Adaptable message.

methods.name: isCreated
methods.description: Checks if the Adaptable message has a status indicating a created response.

methods.name: thingIdFrom
methods.description: Derives a ThingId from the Adaptable's topic path.
